species.real: Southern elephant seals can dive well over a kilometre deep and stay under for more than an hour, deeper than most submarines are built to go.
species.name: Slabpup

dex.text: A round grey sack with enormous wet eyes that has mastered one move, flopping, and is working on a second. Will be big one day, and knows it.
dex.fact: Southern elephant seal pups are weaned after about three weeks, when the mother leaves them; they then fast for a month or two before taking to the sea.

species.real: A beachmaster's nose is an inflatable trunk that works as a loudspeaker for his roar, and he can go weeks without eating while he guards his stretch of beach.
species.name: Beachmaster

dex.text: The loudest thing on the beach, and it has to be: it has a hundred rivals and a harem to keep an eye on. Settles every argument by lying on it.
dex.fact: A big male southern elephant seal, called a beachmaster, can weigh several tonnes and is the largest seal in the world; his name comes from the stretch of shore he defends.
